item.title: Iran's ceasefire push may be a 'cycle of deception,' analysts warn as shadowy figure gains power
item.summary: Iran's shadowy Ahmad Vahidi, a former Quds Force commander linked to deadly bombings abroad, is now more dominant than Iran's president or Khamenei's son, experts warn.

item.title: Turkey’s NATO role under scrutiny amid new report on Hamas, Muslim Brotherhood ties
item.summary: A new Foundation for Defense of Democracies report alleges Turkey under Erdogan has shifted toward Islamist movements, raising NATO alliance concerns ahead of a July summit in Ankara, Turkey.

item.title: Israel approves sweeping death penalty legislation targeting terrorism, EU condemns move
item.summary: Israel's Knesset voted to mandate the death penalty for terrorists convicted of deadly attacks, a shift lawmakers say was driven by the horrors of the Oct. 7 massacre.

item.title: WWE NXT star Sol Ruca readies for emotional match against Zaria at Stand & Deliver
item.summary: Sol Ruca and Zaria's feud will come to a head on Saturday night at NXT Stand & Deliver as their close friendship has fractured over the last few months.

item.title: Former Wisconsin football player, who left the sport amid mental health struggles, dead at 24
item.summary: Former Wisconsin Badgers tight end Jack Pugh has died at 24, the university confirmed. Pugh had stepped away from football in 2023 citing mental health struggles.

item.title: Repeat offender allegedly stabs pregnant mom in random grocery store parking lot attack 'with a steak knife'
item.summary: Marvina Butler-Hardy, a repeat offender, is accused of stabbing a pregnant Charlotte mom in a Harris Teeter parking lot with a steak knife in a random attack.

item.title: Hawaii doctor’s son tells jurors dad confessed cliffside attack on wife, vowed to jump before arrest
item.summary: A son testified he watched his father appear on FaceTime with blood on his shirt and allegedly admit to attacking his wife near a Hawaii cliff trail.

item.title: 'Texas Killing Fields' cold case explodes as suspect indicted in two slayings decades after 30 bodies found
item.summary: James Dolphs Elmore Jr. has been indicted in the "Texas Killing Fields" cold case, accused of manslaughter and tampering with evidence in two victims' deaths.

item.title: Within minutes of Trump signing voter database order, Dem states threaten lawsuits
item.summary: Democratic states immediately threatened to sue President Donald Trump over an executive order restricting mail-in voting and creating a voter eligibility list.

item.title: Rob Riggle admits he joined the Marines after hearing an offhand comment from an FBI agent
item.summary: Actor Rob Riggle says an FBI tip sparked his decision to join the Marines at 19, leading to a 23-year career and eventual rise to lieutenant colonel.
